responses.explanation: Replaced the half-weighted side-moment recipe with explicit unscaled raw connector integrals. Rational degree moments are 2 M_{0,r}; elliptic moments are Euler derivatives of the integral of W_11(t) f(xt) at x=1, with W_11(t) unscaled and no factor 1/2. The rational and elliptic zero-indicator integrals are stated separately. All displayed raw moments, q=1 prefactors and contribution coefficients are unchanged; the interface records this convention.

Removed the undefined one-use source sequence a_l. The existing mu generating series now gives the source kernel as its quotient by 2(1-z); adjacent subtraction multiplies by 1-z and hence converts source factors 8,16,16 to 4,8,8. The initial coefficient mu_0/2=1/2 is explicit, so no negative index or competing a-family is needed. The interface source translation is synchronized.
